map.汇总航班或任务的行李装载件数与总重量，按舱位或人员分组统计，校验是否超出载重限制: Aggregates the piece count and total weight of baggage for a flight or task, grouped by hold or by person, to check against weight limits — for air stowage and baggage management accounting.
map.把一批行李/货物重量录入，算均值、极值与分布，辅助配载与重心估算。: Enter a batch of baggage or cargo weights to get the mean, extremes, and distribution, supporting stowage planning and center-of-gravity estimates.
map.对比不同航段行李均值，预判重心偏移趋势。: Compare mean baggage weight across flight segments to anticipate shifts in the center of gravity.
map.识别异常超重件，提前安排分散装载。: Identify abnormally heavy pieces and arrange distributed loading in advance.
map.：录入 12 件行李重量（kg）：15,18,12,20,16,14,22,19: : entering twelve baggage weights (kg) of 15, 18, 12, 20, 16, 14, 22, 19, 17, 13, 21, 16 gives a mean of about 17.1 kg, a maximum of 22, and a minimum of 12. Use this to estimate total hold weight and a first center-of-gravity value, placing overweight pieces symmetrically.
map.统计行李重量和重心计算什么关系？: What Is the Link Between Baggage Weight Statistics and Center of Gravity?
map.每件重量×力臂=力矩，总和除以总重得实际重心。本工具做重量统计，重心位置需配合各: Each item's weight × its lever arm gives a moment; dividing the total by the total weight gives the real center of gravity. This tool does the weight statistics — locating the center of gravity needs the lever arm of each hold (see the center-of-gravity loading tool).
map.样本太少统计有意义吗？: Is Statistics Meaningful with Too Few Samples?
map.少量样本只能看均值/极值，不能推断分布。建议同舱位、同航线累积到足够样本再评估典: With few samples you can only look at the mean and extremes, not infer the distribution. Accumulate enough samples in the same hold or on the same route before assessing typical values and spread.
